## How it was tested

- [ ] the whole suite passes (`scripts/docker-test.sh` or `cargo test`)

- [ ] documentation in `docs/` and the [changelog](../CHANGELOG.MD) are updated, if users can see the change
- [ ] commit messages follow `feat|fix|docs(module): verb description`
